skills.name: Clouds and Rain of Wushan
skills.description: Yaoji stirs up the clouds and rain of Wushan, expanding the AoE of Miasmic Field to the entire battlefield for 8s. When cast, immediately inflicts 1 stack of Blossom & Blight to enemies within the field's AoE, and then inflicts 1 stack of Blossom & Blight to enemies within the field every 2s. (Blossom & Blight: Each stack increases DMG taken by the target by 3% and deals DMG equal to 25% of Yaoji's ATK per second. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 30s.) This Ultimate can only be cast while possessing a host. If Yaoji is not possessing a host when cast, she immediately possesses the frontmost ally, then casts the Ultimate.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG per second of Blossom & Blight to 40%.
upgrades.level4: Each stack of Blossom & Blight increases DMG taken by enemies by 5%.

skills.name: Twining Clouds
skills.description: Passive: At the start of battle, Yaoji possesses the frontmost ally and becomes Untargetable. While possessing a host, she creates a Miasmic Field in a 4-meter radius around the host. Possession lasts 12s. After leaving the host, she takes 50% less DMG for 5s. When actively cast, deals DMG equal to 150% of ATK to all enemies within the Miasmic Field and inflicts 1 stack of Blossom & Blight.

upgrades.level2: When actively cast, deals DMG equal to 180% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: When actively cast, deals DMG equal to 210% of ATK.
upgrades.level4: Active cast CD is reduced by 30%.

skills.name: Mistborne Erosion
skills.description: Passive: Reduces ATK of enemies within the Miasmic Field by 15% and their healing effects received by 30%.

upgrades.level2: Reduces ATK of enemies within the Miasmic Field by 20%.
upgrades.level3: Reduces healing effects received by enemies within the Miasmic Field by 60%.
upgrades.level4: Reduces ATK of enemies within the Miasmic Field by 25%.

skills.name: Cloudveil Shelter
skills.description: The host takes 30% less DMG for the next 5s and restores 3% of max HP per second. This skill can only be cast while possessing a host.

upgrades.level2: Takes 40% less DMG for the next 5s.
upgrades.level3: Restores 5% of max HP per second.

relic.name: Last Petals Fallen
relic.description: When Blossom & Blight on each enemy first reaches 10 stacks, inflicts Blight on the target. (Blight: Loses 3% of max HP per second, ATK SPD reduced by 30%, and ATK reduced by 30% for 5s.)

upgrades.level2: Each time the host loses 40% of max HP, immediately casts an additional Twining Clouds on enemies within the Miasmic Field.
upgrades.level3: When Blossom & Blight on each enemy first reaches 10 stacks, inflicts Blight on the target. (Blight: Loses 5% of max HP per second, ATK SPD reduced by 50%, and ATK reduced by 50% for 5s.)
upgrades.level4: Each time the host loses 30% of max HP, immediately casts an additional Twining Clouds on enemies within the Miasmic Field.
